source_quotes: blueprint steps are built around ... we based on rules and steps turn rules to steps
provider is just a step type
overlap_check: Blueprint authoring REPORT (docs/evidence/blueprint-authoring) records the conversion. No methodology states it. New.

payload.name: Blueprint Steps Come From Rules
payload.description: A blueprint turns the aggregated methodology rules into steps. Each step cites the rule it carries out, runs as pipeline 9 or a provider, and any unmet real need goes to missing capabilities. Blueprints stay private.

principles.name: Rules become steps
principles.description: The methodology says what must hold; the step is how the walk acts on it.

heuristics.condition: a step cites a rule position that has shifted after a retirement
heuristics.action: re-audit the citation; remove a citation that no longer exists

heuristics.condition: a legacy step type has no current equivalent
heuristics.action: map it to pipeline 9 and note it for review rather than inventing an action

decision_rules.name: One rule, cited step
decision_rules.condition: a blueprint is drafted from the aggregated rules
decision_rules.outcome: give each step the rule it carries out by methodology and rule position, and check by a unanimous batched vote that the step does carry it out before keeping the citation

decision_rules.name: Step types
decision_rules.outcome: use pipeline 9 for model work or a provider step for a registered provider's action; the walk coerces any other pipeline to 9

decision_rules.name: Providers from rules
decision_rules.outcome: translate it into a provider step; do not search for or list tools by guessing

decision_rules.name: Missing capabilities, not fiction
decision_rules.condition: a step needs an action with no registered provider
decision_rules.outcome: record it in missing_capabilities and let capability closure create it

decision_rules.name: Keep blueprints private
decision_rules.condition: a blueprint is stored or a manifest is announced
